summary: Iteration 84 — Mobile HARD BLOCKER from iter83 is FIXED. The manual AsyncStorage persistence in /app/mobile/src/stores/useCartStore.ts (no zustand/middleware) removed the import.meta crash — Expo web preview now boots to the login screen, demo-login-btn renders, /api/auth/me fires (401 pre-login), demo-login logs in as demo@bigfm.dubai and lands on /home. FRONTEND passes on both surfaces. Web checkout gap from iter83 is ALSO closed — /shop/checkout/menu renders Service fee $1.80, UAE VAT (5%) $0.09, Delivery fee $5.00 (delivery toggle) and ETA 'Ready in ~20 min' / 'Arrives in 30–45 min' with a single 'Ready'. Only two minor findings: (1) on mobile, tapping the 'Pay by card' button on /shop/cart creates the order (POST /api/shop/orders/checkout -> ord_XXX) but the user is NOT auto-routed to /shop/order/{id} — the cart stays put. The order is reachable manually from /shop/orders -> order-track-*. (2) On web, the sticky mini-player at the bottom overlaps the fixed menu-checkout pill on /shop/menu; a native Playwright click gets intercepted (a programmatic el.click() works fine and the flow completes). Non-blocking overlay z-index nudge. All mobile testIDs from the request are present with correct values; near-me shows both restaurants and services with distance badges in km; the tracker eta line has a single 'Ready', pickup code and map-fallback all render; the /shop menu 'Choose' buttons at 390px are not clipped (bounding box x=327, w=34 -> right edge 361 < 390).

ui_bugs.component: ShopMenu sticky checkout pill vs global mini-player
ui_bugs.issue: The floating [data-testid='menu-checkout'] pill at the bottom of /shop/menu/* is visually overlapped by the sticky mini-player (RadioLife audio bar) on Desktop 1920px, so a Playwright native .click(force=True) is intercepted by the player. A programmatic el.click() (or a real user press higher on the button) navigates to /shop/checkout/menu correctly. Bump z-index / adjust bottom padding of the menu-checkout container above the player.

ui_bugs.component: Shop cart 'Pay by card' button flow
ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the pay-by-card button at the bottom of /shop/cart successfully calls POST /api/shop/orders/quote + POST /api/shop/orders/checkout and creates an order (e.g. ord_6fcd820ba706), but the app does NOT auto-navigate to /shop/order/{id}. The user remains on /shop/cart with the same items; only /shop/orders shows the new order (and Track button routes correctly to /shop/order/{id}). Expected per test spec: 'Placing the order should route to /shop/order/{id}'.

rca of the issue: iter83 mobile boot hang RCA: `zustand/middleware`'s persist ships an `import.meta` reference which the Expo/Metro web bundler could not transform (metro.config.js is protected). Because the store was imported at module-graph load time by every screen behind AuthProvider, the JS crashed before AuthProvider's boot useEffect ran, leaving auth-splash indefinitely with no /api/auth/me fired. Fix (already applied by main agent): drop zustand/middleware and implement one-shot AsyncStorage rehydrate + subscribe write-back in useCartStore.ts (safe on web because AsyncStorage on web resolves to localStorage via @react-native-async-storage/async-storage's web shim). Verified this iteration: /api/auth/me now fires, demo-login-btn renders, cart persists across page reload on the Expo web preview.
